methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 high-search wireless phone charger models spanning pads, stands, 3-in-1 and 2-in-1 configurations from Anker, Belkin, Apple, ESR, Mophie, Nomad, UGREEN, Spigen, and Baseus. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (anker.com, belkin.com, apple.com, esrtech.com, mophie.com, nomadgoods.com, us.ugreen.com, spigen.com, baseus.com); corroborating sources include Amazon/Best Buy listings and editorial reviews (9to5toys, MacRumors, Macworld, How-To Geek, Cult of Mac, The Gadgeteer). All wattages are peak headline output. priceUsd is published US MSRP/list price. Adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-19 corrected: Anker A2557 price (sale price mistaken for MSRP); Apple MagSafe release date/year (the Qi2 25W MGD74LL/A is the Sept 2025 third-gen model, not the Oct 2024 charger); Mophie certification (Made-for-MagSafe/MFi, not Qi2); ESR source URL (wrong .io domain corrected to .com); Baseus foldable flag (confirmed foldable). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, Foldable Pad) A25M8
products.priceNote: MSRP $109.99 per anker.com (currently on sale to $89.99)
products.provenance: Anker.com product page (re-verified 2026-06-19) confirms list price $109.99 (sale $89.99), 15W Max phone output (5W Watch / 5W earbuds), MPP(Qi2) certified, foldable compact pad, charges iPhone+Apple Watch+AirPods simultaneously, 40W USB-C adapter included. 9to5toys IFA 2024 coverage confirms 2024 release.

products.name: Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station (Foldable 3-in-1) A2557
products.priceNote: MSRP $139.99 per anker.com (currently on sale to $109.99)

Distinct model from the A25M8 pad. September 2024 announcement per 9to5toys IFA coverage.

products.name: Apple MagSafe Charger (1 m) — Qi2 25W (2025)
products.priceNote: MSRP $39 (1 m); $49 for 2 m. Cable only — power adapter sold separately
products.provenance: CORRECTED release date/year: the Qi2 25W-certified MagSafe Charger (model MGD74LL/A) is Apple's THIRD-generation MagSafe Charger, released September 10, 2025 — NOT October 2024. The earlier 2024 charger also did 25W for iPhone but was NOT Qi2-certified. Since this product is named/specced as the Qi2 25W charger, release is 2025-09. MSRP $39 (1 m) / $49 (2 m) confirmed by Apple.com and MacRumors; requires a separately-sold 30W+ USB-C adapter for full 25W; charges one device. Fabricated How-To Geek '2024 review' corroboration replaced with the MacRumors launch article.

products.name: Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charging Pad with Qi2 15W (WIZ021)
products.priceNote: MSRP $79.99 per belkin.com product page (SKU WIZ021ttBK, shown as "$79.99"); frequently discounted at third-party retailers.
products.provenance: Belkin.com (SKU WIZ021ttBK) confirms the exact model — "BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charging Pad with Qi2 15W" — at a verbatim $79.99 price, 15W wireless output (Technical Specs "Wattage 15W"), "Equipped with Qi2" / MagSafe-compatible, and a 30W USB-C power supply included in the box; it charges an iPhone at 15W, AirPods at 5W on a second pad, and an additional device via a 5W USB-C port. The Amazon Belkin-store listing (ASIN B0CRSVJQMD, Style "2 in 1") corroborates identity and specs: "Wattage 15 watts", Included Components list the "30W USB-C power supply", and the Special Feature reads "Charge 3 Devices At Once" — supporting devices_charged=3. Distinguished from the sibling WIZ026 (travel pad) and WIZ032 (3-in-1 stand); no release year is stated on either fetched page, so release_year/releaseDate are left null.

products.name: Samsung 15W Wireless Charger Duo (EP-P5400)
products.priceNote: No US MSRP could be sourced verbatim from a fetched page. Samsung's US product page redirects to a generic accessories listing (model discontinued in US) and the Amazon listing (B09VKYT9K6) rendered localized EUR pricing (EUR 47.64), not a US MSRP; Walmart's US listing was bot-blocked. priceUsd left null rather than guessed.
products.provenance: Samsung Hong Kong's official product page (samsung.com/hk_en, model EP-P5400TWEGGB, "15W Wireless Charger Duo Pad P5400 with TA") confirms the exact model and states "up to 15W of Fast Charging support", USB Type-C interface, simultaneous two-device charging (phone + Galaxy Watch, or Watch + earbuds), and packaging contents "Wireless charger, 25W TA, 1M DLC, Manual" — i.e. the 25W travel adapter is included (power_adapter_included=true). Amazon's US listing for the same model (ASIN B09VKYT9K6; Model Number EP-P5400 / Mfr Part Number EP-P5400BBEGWW, "Samsung 15W Duo Fast Wireless Charger Pad") corroborates the "up to 15W" output, Wireless Charging Standard "Qi" (no Qi2/MagSafe, no magnets → qi2_or_magsafe=false, certification "Qi"), "Number of Items 2" / "Total USB Ports 2" (devices_charged=2), the in-box "25W TA", and "Portable: No" (non-foldable). No US MSRP was sourceable: Samsung's US page redirects to a generic accessories listing and Amazon rendered localized EUR pricing (EUR 47.64), so priceUsd and release year are left null rather than guessed.

products.name: Mophie 3-in-1 Extendable Stand with MagSafe
products.priceNote: US MSRP $150.00 per mophie.com product page ("$150.00"); Macworld review states $150 and Verizon lists $149.99.
products.provenance: mophie.com lists this product — now cataloged as the "Wireless Desktop Charging Station - Office/Studio Edition," the same SKU — at $150.00 with "up to 15W" Made-for-MagSafe output, a 5W AirPods spot, an Apple Watch charger, an extendable stand from 7.5" to 16", a weighted steel base, and "Wall Charger" listed in What's in the box (adapter included). Macworld's dated review (Feb 1, 2024) confirms model identity under the exact retail name "3-in-1 Extendable Stand with MagSafe": MFi-certified, 15W, 7.5"–16" height adjustment, three devices, at $150 (Verizon corroborates the exact name at $149.99). The 7.5"–16" extension range, 15W MagSafe output, weighted steel base and $150 price match verbatim across the manufacturer page and the review, confirming this is the exact model rather than a sibling or other-capacity variant; no page states a release year, so it is left null.

products.name: ESR HaloLock Kickstand Wireless Charger (Qi2 15W)
products.priceNote: Regular price $23.97 on the ESR product page (esrtech.com), listed in USD with no active discount (Regular price and Sale price both $23.97). Ships with a USB-C cable only; no wall adapter included.
products.provenance: The esrtech.com product page (browser title "Qi2 15W Fast Wireless Charging Pad with Stand"; variant "Magnetic Charging Pad (15W, Kickstand)", handle qi2-mini-kickstand-wireless-charger-halolock) confirms this exact HaloLock Qi2 15W kickstand model — distinct from the non-kickstand "15W mini Charger" puck and the older iPhone 12/13/14 MagSafe kickstand — with a stable 15W output, a 0°-70° adjustable kickstand, and a listed Regular price of $23.97 (USD). Amazon listing B0DHZ851MN ("ESR HaloLock for Magsafe Charger with Kickstand, 15W", model number 2C577, Form Factor "charging pad with kickstand", Wattage 15 watts) corroborates the 15W single-device MagSafe/Qi magnetic pad and that only a 1.5 m USB-C cable is included with "Power Plug: No Plug" (no wall adapter), matching a customer review noting "it did not come with the wall charger". ESR markets/labels the unit as "Qi2" (certification set to Qi2); neither page publishes a release year, so release_year and releaseDate are left null.

products.name: Twelve South ButterFly 2-in-1 MagSafe Charger
products.priceNote: Regular price $79.99 per twelvesouth.com product page (listed verbatim as "Regular price $ 79.99"). Original launch MSRP was $129.99 / $130 per the Dec 2023 MacRumors and 9to5toys reviews; the manufacturer's current price has since dropped to $79.99, which is used here.
products.provenance: Twelve South's official product page (twelvesouth.com/products/butterfly-2-in-1-magsafe-charger) confirms this exact model — the "ButterFly 2-in-1 MagSafe Charger," the world's smallest 2-in-1 USB-C MagSafe charger — with a 15W MagSafe pad for iPhone plus a 5W Apple Watch fast charger, a design that folds to 2.25 x 1 in, and a 30W USB-C power adapter with four international plug adapters included; the page lists "Regular price $ 79.99." The MacRumors review (dated Dec 15 2023) corroborates identity and specs (15W MagSafe iPhone charging matching Apple's own MagSafe charger, Apple Watch fast charging, 30W adapter with swappable US/EU/UK/AU plugs, foldable palm-size 2-in-1 that also charges MagSafe AirPods) and states Twelve South launched it "earlier this month," dating release to December 2023; the 9to5toys review (Dec 19 2023) independently confirms the same. Both reviews quote the original $129.99/$130 launch price, but the live manufacturer MSRP is now $79.99; release_year 2023 and the 15W output appear verbatim on all three fetched pages.

products.name: Native Union Rise 3-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charger (Qi2)
products.priceNote: US listed price $139.99 on nativeunion.com US store (verbatim "$139.99"), for the base 3-in-1 version without wall adapter. Amazon B0DMN563QP currently shows "No featured offers available" / "List unavailable", so the price is manufacturer-sourced only.
products.provenance: Native Union's official US product page (fetched with ?country=US so the USD figure re-fetches verbatim) confirms this exact model — "Rise 3-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charger", "Qi2 certified & MagSafe compatible", charge "up to 15W", "Charges three devices simultaneously" (iPhone + AirPods + Apple Watch), "Foldable multi-device charging stand" — and lists the US price as $139.99. Its specifications section states the unit "Must be paired with a USB-C (>35W PD) power adapter (not included)" and lists only the charger, 2m USB-C cable and travel pouch in the box, so the base version ships without an adapter (a separate "with adapter" version exists), giving power_adapter_included=false. Amazon listing B0DMN563QP corroborates the identical model (title "Native Union Rise 3-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charger – Qi2 Certified & MagSafe – 15W", "Wattage 15 watts", "Form Factor Foldable Charging Stand", two styles "3-IN-1" and "3-IN-1 with adapter") and a Vine reviewer confirms the base SKU "does not include the charging brick"; neither page states a release year, so release_year and releaseDate are null.
